summary: Installed and integrated AOS (Animate On Scroll) library into PortalSifast. Steps: (1) npm install aos + @types/aos; (2) Imported AOS CSS in app.css; (3) Initialized AOS in app.tsx with duration 400ms, ease-out-cubic easing, once:true, offset 40px, and prefers-reduced-motion support; (4) Added router.on('finish') listener to call AOS.refresh() after each Inertia navigation so animations work on page transitions; (5) Applied data-aos='fade-up' with stagger delays on web-official/index.tsx module cards as a demo. Build succeeded in 18.93s.
current_status: PortalSifast has AOS fully integrated. The new color palette (PS Network blue #0070d1, charcoal sidebar, true black dark mode) is active. AOS is globally initialized and refreshes on every Inertia page change. web-official/index.tsx uses fade-up animations with delay stagger. Other pages can easily add data-aos attributes.
